steps: Drain and rinse the Cooked chickpeas, then pat dry with a clean towel.
In a medium bowl, combine Cooked chickpeas, Mashed avocado, Lemon juice, Olive oil, and Ground cumin.
Mash the mixture with a fork until mostly smooth with some small chunks remaining.
Wash the Cucumbers and slice each into 16 rounds, each about 2 cm thick.
Use a small spoon to hollow a shallow well in the centre of each Cucumber round.
Spoon about 1 teaspoon of the chickpea smash into each Cucumber cup.
Scatter Fresh dill over the filled cups to finish.
Arrange on a plate and serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 1 day in an airtight container.
